question.worked_solution:
If $X∼\text{Geom}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}(1-p)^{x-1}p, & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, $X∼\text{Geom}(0.63),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}{(0.37)}^{x-1}(0.63), & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X<4) & =P(X\in \{1,2,3\}) \\  & =P(X=1)+P(X=2)+P(X=3) \\  & =f(1)+f(2)+f(3) \\  & ={(0.37)}^{0}(0.63)+{(0.37)}^{1}(0.63)+{(0.37)}^{2}(0.63) \\  & ≈0.9493.\end{aligned}
$$
